steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Give me a heads-up about planned ops next time, will you, Chief...? I really thought you'd been captured! I was scared out of my mind!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It was thanks to your convincing reaction that we managed to deceive them. Thank you, Captain Eugene.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: ...You're welcome, but let someone else do it next time maybe?

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: You did an excellent job too, Hecate. None of them suspected a thing.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I've observed Elvira for a long time. I know how to do her.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: All I had to do was hide in Jelena's arms.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Alright, alright, would any of our brave ones be willing to drop by the 9th Agency and make a statement? The boss is waiting.
Everyone gets out of the car, the negotiators being escorted to the Bureau first. After a moment's thought, you walk toward the front seat.
The car window rolls down, and the man inside flashes you a bright smile.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: This is our second time working together, always spot-on! Ever thought about becoming a permanent member of my team?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Whether you're out to uncover the truth, shake up the city, or simply protect someone—having a Prime Minister by your side could always smooth things out.
Your response escapes your lips almost reflexively.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As you've seen, I'm easily ticked off. Political games just aren't my thing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You want to know more about the West District, right? I've recommended some trustworthy friends from the Executive Committee to Adrian. Maybe you can sort something out with them. As for me...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm knee-deep in my cases now, all the while having a bunch of secrets to keep. You wouldn't want a partner who can't shoot for something wild, would you?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: ...I could really use your help right now. But hey, what can I say... There's always next time!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Next time, when you've wrapped up your cases and I've won the election, we can talk about working together again. Great minds always find their way back to each other.
You smile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Honestly, I know nothing about the election, nor do I want to. That position has never seemed to make any difference in the things I truly care about. If it really holds the value you say...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then please win and prove yourself by making real changes. Who knows? By then, I might be the one not letting you go.

Max King smiles. It could be just your imagination, but the typical self-importance in his expression appears to have softened slightly. His gaze shifts to the road ahead, fixed on something in the distance.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Chief, I've never doubted once that I would make my dreams come true and change this city. But it's only when I walk alongside you that this vision feels closer than ever before, almost within reach.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: So, as long as I haven't thrown in the towel, I'll keep coming back to you.
You shrug and turn to his reliable right-hand man in the driver's seat.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Always such a bullhead, is he?

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Hehe, don't worry. I've got his back.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: This world needs Master King's vision, and I'll make sure to lift him to his rightful heights.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Until next time, Chief! Feel free to reach out if you need anything. We're friends now, after all.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: And even if you don't jump on board with the campaign, you're still a DisCitizen. Just cast your vote! Your vote would mean a lot to me.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: That depends on you, not me.

steps.content: You exchange a final handshake before his limo glides away into the distance.
Now it's just you and one other person remaining. She has been silently observing you with a faint smile, perhaps since only moments ago, or possibly for a while now.
Jelena freezes in surprise, clearly caught off guard by your sudden display of pride.
But she swiftly regains her composure, her smile blossoming in the sunlight.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Yes, great progress indeed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well, if only things could continue to go this way...
You gesture politely to invite her back to the Bureau, but someone has already come out to greet both of you.
Elvira rushes straight into Jelena's embrace. You step back, returning the butler to her young lady.
